question: Sundari trees are found in the ______.
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Ganga-Brahmaputra delta.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **species of mangrove tree **found in the **Malvaceae family** is called ***Heritiera fomes*__. **
 
• **Sunder, sundri, jekanazo, and pinlekanazo** are some of its common names.
 
• It makes up around **70% of the trees **in the **Sundarbans of Bangladesh and India** and is the main type of mangrove tree there.
 
• **__*H. fomes*__** is a significant tree that** produces lumber.**
 
• The Sundari tree can be found in the **Ganga-Brahmaputra delta.**
 
• They are also known as the **Sunderbans** due to the large number of these trees in those areas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Mahanadi delta:**

 
 
• **Mangroves and** their allies are found in great variety in the Mahanadi delta, which includes the districts of** Kendrapara, Jagatsinghpur, and Puri.**
 
• It is situated on India's east coast in the state of **Odisha.**
 
 
 
• **Godavari delta:**
 
 
• The States of **Telangana, Maharashtra, Chhattisgarh, and Andhra Pradesh **make up this interstate subbasin.
 
• **Avicennia, Suaeda, Rhizophora, and Bruguiera species** are among the distinguishing trees; they are the **typical genera of Asia-Pacific mangroves.**
 
 
 
• **Muthupet delta:**
 
 
• In the southernmost tip of the **Cauvery river delta**, on the Gulf of Bengal, is** Muthupet Lagoon.**
 
• This beautiful area is usually green thanks to the **mangrove vegetation. **
